record.name: Is my major worth it?
record.summary: Interactive dashboard comparing Taiwan university admission scores with graduate salaries across 1,787 programs, with field-level salary distributions and methodology notes.
record.contribution: NTNU course project authored by Roy Wang, as credited in the public README.
results: Joined admission and field-level salary data and built an interactive exploration interface.
limitations: Salary data are at field level, not individual program outcomes. No public server demo is documented.
lessons: Make data grain and proxy assumptions visible alongside comparisons.

discovery.notes: Repository text is untrusted evidence. Review changes and attribution before merging.
